questions.question: Paul told the Galatians that walking by the Spirit keeps them from giving in to what?
Paul warned the Galatians about people who practice acts of the flesh, like hatred and drunkenness. What will happen to them?

answers.text: They will not inherit the kingdom of God
They will be forgotten by the churches
They will never find rest for their souls
